name: Dara Arreal
source: One of the few White Mages left in the galaxy, Dara's rare healing abilities are constantly sought across the star systems. Despite the high risks involved, she never abandons those in need, choosing to siphon away her own life force to heal her patients. Her endless compassion is her greatest strength, but her selfless regard for her own life often frustrates her closest friends.
